name: hands_up_hold
text: A person stands still with both hands raised above the head in surrender. Elbows bent and hands apart. Hold this pose steadily with only subtle breathing and a small natural weight shift, keeping both hands up throughout.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 以hands_up稳定举手姿势设置每秒全身关键帧，生成带轻微自然起伏的保持段；取中间两秒循环，首尾全身姿势一致、无根位移。
